components.name: Sharp realized lower-band root-image separation
components.project_addition: Use exact P017 cofactor windows together with the P007 quotient-window lift and P023 actual-image separation test to replace enlarged candidate-pair collisions by realized root images. Prove that for every k>=9, distinct lower-band least-prime shells have pairwise disjoint actual square-root images; k=8,p=2,r=3,root=5 is a sharp witness. This strengthens realized shell-channel separation relative to L052's k>=15 candidate-pair threshold without invalidating L052's coarser statement. Historical novelty remains unverified.
